target.title: fix(msteams): page channel thread replies
target.body:
﻿Closes #98870

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Microsoft Teams channel users in long thread conversations would lose the newest replies from agent context once the thread had more than 50 replies.

## Why This Change Was Made

Teams Graph returns channel message replies oldest-first and exposes additional pages through `@odata.nextLink`. This change uses the existing bounded Graph pagination helper for thread replies and then retains the newest requested replies, keeping the fix inside the Teams plugin's Graph thread boundary.

## User Impact

Agents responding in long Teams channel threads can now see the most recent relevant replies instead of being limited to the oldest first page of replies.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: `fetchThreadReplies` now requests replies through bounded Graph pagination and returns the newest limited reply window.
- Commands / artifacts:
  - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` completed successfully after the worktree initially lacked `node_modules`.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/graph-thread.test.ts` passed: 1 test file, 28 tests.
  - `git diff --check` passed.
  - `PYTHONUTF8=1 python .agents\\skills\\autoreview\\scripts\\autoreview --mode local` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: focused tests cover the paginated helper call, newest-reply limit behavior, minimum/maximum limit handling, empty results, and the explicit 50-page cap.
- Not tested / proof gaps: no live Microsoft Teams tenant / Graph API integration proof was run; validation is focused unit coverage plus existing Graph pagination helper coverage.
